author: reek
body: HTTP server for Spark Studio. Serves the HTML page, WASM binary, CSS, JS, and a live API. Static files are read from a FAT16 disk image attached to the VM's IDE controller. Binary files (WASM) use HttpBinaryResponse; text files use HttpResponse.

author: reek
body: Reads a file from the FAT16 volume and serves it with the correct MIME type. Binary files (wasm, png) use http-encode-binary; text files use http-encode.

author: reek
body: Handles an incoming HTTP request: parse, route, build response, send raw bytes over TCP using net-io-send-raw.
